name: Aggem Thorncurse
summary: Aggem Thorncurse is a living quilboar shaman in Razorfen Kraul, bearing the title Death's Head Prophet. He calls a boar spirit to his aid when threatened.

sections.title: The Death's Head Prophet
sections.body: Aggem guards a part of Razorfen Kraul occupied by the Death's Head tribe. His shamanic powers include summoning a boar spirit, reflecting the quilboar's reverence for Agamaggan.

faq.answer: Aggem is a quilboar shaman and Death's Head Prophet in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can Aggem Thorncurse be found?
faq.answer: He is found inside Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens.

faq.q: What spirit does Aggem call upon?
faq.answer: Aggem summons a boar spirit to fight beside him.

faq.q: How does Aggem fight in combat?
faq.answer: Aggem uses shamanic magic and summons a boar spirit to fight beside him.

faq.q: Is Aggem Thorncurse affiliated with a specific quilboar tribe?
faq.answer: He belongs to the Death's Head tribe.

angles.text: Aggem calls a boar spirit to aid him, a distinctive expression of quilboar shamanism.
His title of prophet reflects the spiritual traditions of the quilboar.
With the quilboar constantly menacing the Barrens, putting down persistent defenders like Aggem Thorncurse helps secure the lands of Durotar and Mulgore.
